claims: Conan O'Brien is hosting the 98th Academy Awards (Oscars 2026).
The 98th Academy Awards are on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards are at Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
Conan O'Brien's hosting of the 98th Academy Awards marks his second consecutive year hosting the ceremony.
The announcement was made by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences.
Raj Kapoor and Katy Mullan are returning as executive producers for the 98th Academy Awards.
